{{Youmay|the [[City/Legends|city]]|the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Garan (individual)|Garan]]}}
'''Garan''' was the agricultural and manufacturing center of [[Garos IV]]. It was connected to [[Ariana]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mining base near [[Mount Usca]] by the [[Currahen Crossroad]].
